xp.content_hint: Formatting, lists and links are kept; scripts, styles and embedded frames are removed when the page is saved.
xp.delete_page_text: The page and its menu entries are removed, and nobody can open it any more. The audit log keeps a record.
xp.form_host_hint: The page shows the form's records list. People also need permission to view the form.
xp.key_hint: Used in packages and links; it cannot change later.
xp.link_external: This page opens another website in a new tab.
xp.link_internal: This page opens another place in the application.
xp.load_failed: Could not load. Please try again.
xp.name: Name
xp.page_access_hint: Grant who may open this page in Roles & Permissions, on:
xp.page_subtitle: A page placed in the menu, with its own permission.
xp.page_unavailable: This page is not available to you.
xp.pages_empty_text: Create a page for guidance, links or a dashboard, then add it to the menu.
xp.pages_subtitle: Pages hold content, links, or a dashboard, report or form, and are placed in the menu like any form. Each page has its own permission.
xp.published_desc: Only published pages can be opened. A draft can be edited without anyone seeing it.
xp.reports_unavailable: Choosing a report or dashboard needs the "Manage reports and dashboards" permission.
xp.url_hint: An address starting with https://, or a path in this application starting with /.
